Maggie: wrapping up my 06:00-12:00 UTC handoff. Quick summary:
- Incidents: embedding service rate-limiter tripped causing 503s for batch /v1/embed/batch jobs 08:12-08:35 UTC. KV cache eviction rate rose ~3x but no OOMs.
- Mitigations done: rolled back rate-limit canary to v2 (manual rollback), scaled embed-dedicated pool +2 GPUs, enabled fallback to quant-small model for low-priority batch lanes, bumped kvcache max_entries temporarily.
- Next steps: monitor error rate for 30m, open postmortem ticket (INC-2026-347) with timeline & rollback rationale, follow up to add API-level circuit breaker for batch endpoints. Handoff to Jen for night watch. Logs & metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/embeds/embeds-overview (internal)

Rahul: which customer routes saw the most 503s? Was the rollback a deploybot rollback or manual config flip?

Maggie: impacted mainly /v1/embed/batch (external customers) and internal /embed/sync. Rollback was manual via deploybot: `deploybot rollback embed-config --to v2` — did that at 08:23 UTC. Error rate back to baseline ~08:40.

Kai: I left a grep of the 503s and a short flame graph in the incident ticket. Also ran a safe cache trim script to reduce eviction churn. Snippet I ran: 
```
# scale pool
rci scale pool embed-dedicated --gpus +2
# rollback config
deploybot rollback embed-config --to v2
```

oncall-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: Embed 503 spike cleared at 08:40 UTC. Incident INC-2026-347 marked resolved.

Jen: taking over. I'll keep an eye on tail error rate and queue depth. Will follow up tomorrow morning with any regression signal. Ping me @maggie if it pops back up. :thumbsup:

Maggie: thanks team — I've added mitigation notes and links to INC-2026-347, assigned owner for the circuit-breaker follow-up to @kai. Leaving shift now.
